title: Bitwarden Secrets Manager access token (0. + UUID layout): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: 1 glued before 0., so the run reads 10.<uuid>, boundary: v glued before 0., so the run reads v0.<uuid>, and boundary: x glued after the closing ==. Twin of "Bitwarden Secrets Manager access token (0. + UUID layout): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of bitwarden-secrets-manager-access-token-bare-prose: boundary: 1 glued before 0., so the run reads 10.<uuid>. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
